mel: s3 metadata: x-amz-meta-cmek-id: abcd-ef01-2345; x-amz-meta-upload-id: bkup-20251003-tn142

raj: Grant expiry would explain missing Decrypt audit entries, but InvalidCiphertext usually implies key/context mismatch or corruption.
alice: Confirm if uploader changed encryption-context format recently. KMS Decrypt requires the same encryption context to succeed.
mel: Trying repro steps locally, pasting outputs.
mel: ```bash
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket backups --key tn142/bkup-20251003
{ "Metadata": { "cmek-id": "abcd-ef01-2345", "uploader": "uploader-service-v2" }}
```

jo: uploader-service-v2 flipped to a new encryption-context schema last week. If decrypt attempted with old context it will fail even with same key.
raj: Check uploader logs for `encryption_context` field; we should also look for mismatched aliases (key rotation).
alice: Short-term mitigation: run restore using an uploader instance snapshot from the original upload timeframe so it uses identical context. Long-term: enforce structured encryption-context in upload telemetry and include it in backup metadata.
